full_judgment:
predecessor of opposite party nos. 1-7 and 1 I as plaintiff filed Other Suit no. 28 of 1992. subsequently, the same was renumbered as Other Suit no. 174 of 1992 in the Court of Senior Assistant Judge, Banskhali, Chittagong for declaration of her title. Later on, through amendment the further declaration was sought for that the deed of relinquishment dated 1 1.04.1933 is illegal, forged and not binding upon the plaintiff contending inter-ilia that 40 acres or land appertaining to R.S. khatian no. 705 of Chechoria mouza originally belonged to Joy Kumar who died leaving wife Kamini Bala Das having no son. 

 4. Kamini Bala Das has been possessing the suit land after the death of her husband Joy Kumar. The P.S and B.S khatian have been rightly recorded in the name of Kamini Bala Das though inadvertently Joy, Kumar has been shown as the father of Kamini Bala Das instead of her husband. In the B.S khatian there appears a wrong entry into the column of possession that the defendants are in possession of the suit land. But the said entry is erroneous. Kamini Bala Das did not induct them as her permissive possessor. Joy Kumar did not execute and register any deed of relinquishment in favour of Pran Hari Acharja and Sree Hari Acharja and on the basis of the said deed of relinquishment, Pran Hari Acharja and Sree Hari Acharja did not get possession of the suit land. The defendants taking the ad~ antaucs of the wrong entry in the column of possession of B.S khatian threatened Kamini Bala Das with dispossession on 25.02.1992, hence the suit. 

 9. The P.S khatian of the suit land is wrong which had just followed the R.S khatian. At the time of preparation of B.S. record of right, the defendants could not show their title deeds to the concerned officer, as such, though their possession into the suit land has been recorded but their names were not recorded in the columns of tenants. The plaintiffs have tiled a false suit and they are not entitled to get any relief in the suit and the suit is liable to be dismissed with costs. 

 15. He further submits that in recent record of right which is known as B.S record of right; the possession of the defendants have been rightly recorded in B.S khatian no. 572. So, the B.S record of right ultimately shows that the predecessor of present defendants i.e. PanMohon Das, Sukumar Das and Lalit Mohon got the suit land by the patta dated 11.04.1933 from Pran Hari Acharja and Sree Hari Acharja. But the appellate Court below on the wrong application of law came to a wrong conclusion that they did not acquire any interest into the suit land. So, the Rule is liable to be made absolute setting aside the impugned judgment and decree of the appellate Court below restoring those of the judgment passed by the trial Court. 

 26. The learned Advocate for the plaintiff-opposite parties put much emphasis on the record of right. It is fact that the R.S record of right stands in the name of-Joy Kumar. It is pertinent to point out here that in between 1925 to 1933 Joy Kumar was exercising his right, title and interest into the suit land and that was the time when the R.S record of right was prepared in that particular locality. So, in that view of the matter, there appears no harm and wrong in recording the name of Joy Kumar in R.S record of right of the suit land and it is known to us that at the time of preparation of P.S khatian or S.A khatian after the acquisition of rent receiving interest by the Government, the S.A record of right was prepared relying on the previous record of right and in that view of the matter it is very much natural and probable that the P.S or S.A record of right will be prepared in the name of,/ Joy Kumar as R.S record of right stands in his name.
